Use case: style-transfer. One substantial NEW REDRAW medieval dialogue HEAD portrait for a logical 74 x 100 pixel slot, portrait canvas ratio exactly 74:100. True transparent background. First input is the OLD identity reference ONLY: preserve character, hair, age and clothing color family, not chibi proportions, big white eyes or full body. Inputs 2–5 are STYLE ONLY: the approved four core head portraits; match tight close face framing, large angular nose/cheekbone shading planes and economical connected pixel clusters, do not borrow their facial identity.
Treat this as a deliberately designed 74x100 low-resolution portrait enlarged by integer nearest-neighbor: very coarse connected hard-edged clusters about 2–8 logical pixels wide, 4–5 skin tones, no soft digital painting. A temporary maximum of 32 matte working colors overall. Exactly one complete recognizable adult head at three-quarter angle toward image-left, nearly filling the canvas, but fully preserve hair silhouette and visible ears with at least 2–3 logical pixels of transparent margin at top and sides. Full crown near y=3, eyebrows around y=34, nose about y=53, beard chin around y=87, tiny collar band at y=90–99. Short barely visible neck, narrow collar slice; NO torso, chest, full shoulders or hands. Start with this EXTREMELY TIGHT LARGE FACE framing.
Both eyes small, low-contrast dark ochre/taupe slivers under dark lids, dark pupils, zero white blocks or catchlights. No bright gray/cream eye whites. Hair and beard must be composed of 3–4 broad SOLID CONNECTED shadow/halftone masses each, no individual hairs, scratchy lines, stripe bundles or highlight dots. Nose bridge, nose tip, cheekbone and jaw are recognizable hard planar volumes, not flat cute face. Warm directional top-left light and dark umber/cool brown shadow. No antialias, blur, smooth gradients, dithering, tiny wrinkle noise, realistic skin texture, decorative flecks, frame, text, watermark or background.
Subject: FIL (菲勒·火), man around fifty, stocky old-weaving-street foreman. Lock the OLD identity: very HIGH RECEDING HAIRLINE with large bare forehead, short swept-back brown/gray side hair, broad square fleshy face, SHORT BROAD blunt nose, broad cheek planes, compact SQUARED GRAY BEARD and gray moustache. Keep a few dark gray masses, not white facial hair. Lower eyelid tiredness as one broad shadow per side. Expression is pragmatic attention with guarded care: thick brows almost LEVEL, slightly asymmetrical outer brow, steady eyes, firmly closed mouth, NO raised inner eyebrows, no worried/pity look, no enraged scowl. Hairline makes him clearly older than the four references. At the very bottom show ONLY a narrow dull SEA-BLUE worn foreman's jacket collar and small dirty linen inner neckline. No book, whistle, insignia, armor or contract. His kindness and proprietary tension coexist, not a saint or tyrant. The whole head rather than clothes is the focus.
